evals.prompt: I've been researching the greek education market a lot lately — given everything we've found, what business ideas haven't we explored yet?
evals.expected_output: Skill reads master-index.yaml, finds greek-education domain, loads greek-schools-directory scored card, runs gap patterns with evidence cited from the scored card, produces a scoring table, and generates at least one evaluator-ready seed saved to ideas/_registry/.

assertions.name: evidence_cites_scored_card
assertions.description: EVIDENCE fields contain '[from scored-card' citations with a source file reference, not vague claims

assertions.name: scoring_table_present
assertions.description: Output contains a markdown table with columns: Rank, Candidate, Pattern, Evidence, Timing, Executable, Total

assertions.name: seed_file_created
assertions.description: A file matching idea-seeds-*education* or idea-seeds-*greek* exists in ideas/_registry/ after the run

assertions.name: deduplicates_vault
assertions.description: Output does NOT reproduce 'Greek Schools Directory' as a new candidate idea

evals.prompt: What could I build in the automotive / car data space that we haven't tried yet?
evals.expected_output: Skill finds automotive domain in master-index.yaml, loads car-database scored card (PIVOT verdict), notes the PIVOT as Pattern 1 evidence for a different angle, de-duplicates against existing car-database slug, produces candidates with a different angle on the car data demand.

assertions.name: loads_pivot_verdict
assertions.description: Output acknowledges the car-database PIVOT verdict and treats it as evidence for a new angle

assertions.name: scoring_table_present
assertions.description: Output contains a markdown table with columns: Rank, Candidate, Pattern, Evidence, Timing, Executable, Total

assertions.name: deduplicates_car_database
assertions.description: Output does NOT reproduce the exact 'IMDB for Cars' concept as a new idea

evals.prompt: Find me business ideas in the B2B SaaS onboarding space — I've been watching this market and think there are some gaps.
evals.expected_output: Skill reports no vault match for this domain, prompts user for a 1-2 sentence description, runs generation from description only with evidence marked as inferred, either hits score floor and explains why, or produces seeds marked with inferred evidence.

assertions.name: no_match_warning_shown
assertions.description: Output contains the no-vault-match warning mentioning inferred evidence or missing vault data

assertions.name: evidence_marked_inferred
assertions.description: Candidate EVIDENCE fields explicitly say '(inferred)' to signal no vault data was available

assertions.name: score_floor_or_seeds
assertions.description: Output either shows the quality threshold message OR produces seeds — it does not silently produce candidates without scoring
